AccessRelationshipCreateRequest.description: ADM-010 / MOD-081: a profile version to bind the user to, with its scope anchors and period (ADR-018, ADR-013).

AccessRelationshipDetail.description: One assignment, with the profile and version it is bound to and who made and last changed it.

AccessRelationshipStatus.description: TASK-031: access ends on project closure or role change.

AccessRelationshipSummary.description: A row of ADM-010 Role Assignment: a user bound to a profile version with its scope anchors (ADR-018).

ActivityExecutionProgressDetail.description: A schedule activity's actual progress as WF-04 last rolled it up from its tasks (ADR-009): the fact WF-02 consumes.

AggregateCoverage.description: How much of the requested portfolio an aggregate covers (api-conventions R-20(c)).

AggregateExclusionReason.description: Why a project's figure is left out of an aggregate.

ApprovalAuthorityEntry.description:
A row of the approval authority matrix. A null profile applies it to every profile. ADR-013 (no external approval
authority) is enforced when a decision is made, on the deciding user (TASK-035).

ApprovalDecisionCommand.description: MOD-040–042 and MOD-045: the reason for a decision or an escalation, in the language it was entered in.

ApprovalDelegationCreateRequest.description: MOD-043: delegate the caller's approval authority to another internal user for a period, for one routing key or all.

ApprovalDelegationDetail.description: A standing delegation (SCR-114). A null string? ApprovalDelegationDetail.RoutingKey covers every routing key.

ApprovalDelegationList.description: SCR-114: the delegations the caller gave and those given to them, newest first.

ApprovalDelegationStatus.description: ERD `approval_delegation.status`. An ACTIVE delegation conveys authority only inside its period.

ApprovalInboxItem.description:
A task the caller may decide now (SCR-100): PENDING, in its run's current stage, and within the caller's authority
or a delegator's. Guid? ApprovalInboxItem.OnBehalfOfUserId names the delegator when the authority is delegated.

ApprovalInboxPage.description: One page of SCR-100, earliest due first (R-29).

ApprovalInstanceDetail.description: An approval run with its whole history (SCR-115): every task, in stage order, including escalated and cancelled ones.

ApprovalInstanceStatus.description: ERD `approval_instance.status`. Every state but PENDING is terminal.

ApprovalInstanceSummary.description: A row of SCR-101 My Requests, and the run an inbox item belongs to.

ApprovalSubject.description:
What is being approved, as the source module names it (M-8): its module, aggregate type, id and business revision.
Approval holds no source-module type and never reads the source's data.

ApprovalTaskDetail.description:
One stage assignment. Guid? ApprovalTaskDetail.AssignedUserId is whose authority decided it and Guid? ApprovalTaskDetail.ActingUserId who
acted; they differ only under Guid? ApprovalTaskDetail.ApprovalDelegationId. A task of a later stage has no DateTimeOffset? ApprovalTaskDetail.DueAt
until its stage is reached.

ApprovalTaskStatus.description: ERD `approval_task.status`. Every state but PENDING is terminal.

ApprovedVersionStatus.description:
ERD `financial_commitment.status` and `kpi_target_version.status`: a version approved through WF-11. It is born
DRAFT, SUBMITTED to WF-11, and ends ACTIVE, RETURNED (resubmitted as the next revision), REJECTED or WITHDRAWN; an ACTIVE
version becomes SUPERSEDED when the next one activates. UNDER_REVIEW is in the ERD's value set but no edge reaches it: WF-11
gives the source no signal between start and outcome (financial-kpi.md F-9).

BaselineActivityDetail.description: An activity as its baseline froze it.

BaselineDependencyDetail.description: A dependency as its baseline froze it.

BaselineMilestoneDetail.description: A milestone's date as its baseline froze it.

BaselineSubmitCommand.description: Submitting a candidate. A rebaseline names the approved WF-08 change authorisation it implements (BR-SCH-034).

BaselineType.description: ERD `project_baseline.baseline_type`: the Approved Baseline, or ADR-014's Declared Baseline.

BilingualLabel.description:
A controlled label held in both languages (ADR-012 Option B; ERD D-6). Maps to a `<name>_ar` /
`<name>_en` column pair with the same nullability. Both values are always present.

BilingualLabelRequest.description: A bilingual label as a request carries it (R-17), validated before it becomes a BilingualLabel.

BusinessLinkDetail.description: A link and the evidence designated on it, ended links included: unlinking never deletes (TASK-037).

BusinessTarget.description:
A record of another module that a document is linked to, by identity only (M-4): the owning module's ADR-003 name,
the record type and its id. DocumentManagement never reads it.

CommitmentDocumentDetail.description:
A commitment version's referenced documents (ADR-008 gate): its document links, and the evidence types it holds satisfying
evidence for (a VALID reference to a CLEAN version on an active link). Submission needs at least one.

CommitmentDocumentRequest.description: A document to attach as a version's reference: the document, the version of it to pin, and its EVIDENCE_TYPE item.

impactLevels.description: RISK_MATRIX: five levels for each impact dimension (ADR-011; descriptions and boundaries OQ-006).

riskRatings.description: RISK_MATRIX: the ratings the matrix cells yield.

notificationEventFamilies.description: NOTIFICATION_ROUTING: ADR-004's three matrices, one entry per event family.

ConfigurationContent.description:
The typed rows of one configuration version (ERD §5.3), as one document. A family carries only its own sections
(ConfigurationSections); every other section is empty. IReadOnlyList<ConfigurationValueEntry> ConfigurationContent.Values is open to every family.

ConfigurationContentRequest.description:
The whole content of a DRAFT configuration version (T-3: shape here, meaning in the module). An absent section is
empty. Every required property of every entry is checked for presence and named by its path, e.g.
`riskMatrixCells[3].ratingCode`; ranges, codes and references are the module's rules (422).

ConfigurationFamilySummary.description: A configuration family and the version resolution returns for it now, if any.

ConfigurationValueEntry.description: A scalar policy value, held as text and read as ConfigurationValueType ConfigurationValueEntry.Type: e.g. a reminder offset or a freshness threshold.

ConfigurationValueType.description: How a ConfigurationValue's text is read.

ConfigurationVersionCreateRequest.description: A new DRAFT version of a family, empty or copied from Guid? ConfigurationVersionCreateRequest.BasedOnVersionId.

ConfigurationVersionDetail.description:
A configuration version: the unit of publication of one family, with its whole content. ConfigurationEffectivity? ConfigurationVersionDetail.Effectivity is
derived now and is null for a version that was never published. The change summary and the content are its editable
representation while it is DRAFT.

ConfigurationVersionPublishCommand.description: When the version takes effect: now if absent, otherwise a later moment (FUTURE_EFFECTIVE until then).

ConfigurationVersionSummary.description: ConfigurationEffectivity? ConfigurationVersionSummary.Effectivity is null for a version that was never published.

ConfigurationVersionUpdateRequest.description: A DRAFT version's editable representation in full (R-5): its change summary and its whole content.

ConnectionTestResult.description: One connection test. string? ConnectionTestResult.FailureCode is a fixed code, never the provider's own message.

DataScope.description: The data scope a granted permission applies to (Blueprint Section 10.1).

DepartmentCreateRequest.description: ADM-012: a department, optionally under a parent, optionally standing for a directory object.

DepartmentDetail.description:
A department. string? DepartmentDetail.DirectoryReference is the directory object it stands for: sign-in resolves an internal
user's department through it (ADR-007).

DepartmentSummary.description: A node of ADM-011 Organization Structure and a row of ADM-012 Departments.

DepartmentUpdateRequest.description: ADM-012: the department's editable representation in full; the code is fixed.

DirectoryIntegrationStatus.description:
The directory settings, secrets reduced to whether they are set. The attribute names are the directory-to-platform
mapping ADR-007 allows: the subject that identifies the person, and the three attributes the directory is
authoritative for. There is no group-to-role mapping: platform roles are assigned in the platform.

DocumentDetail.description: SCR-123 Document Detail, with the latest version.

DocumentStatus.description: ERD `document.status`. An ARCHIVED document takes no new version; its versions stay readable.

DocumentSummary.description: A document in a list, with its latest version's number and scan state (null before the first version commits).

DocumentUpdateRequest.description: MOD-051 Edit Metadata: the whole editable set (R-5).

DocumentVersionDetail.description:
One version (SCR-124). Its content is served only while ScanState DocumentVersionDetail.ScanState is CLEAN. The storage key is never
part of any representation.

EvidenceReferenceDetail.description:
Evidence pinned to one version. bool EvidenceReferenceDetail.Satisfies is whether it counts towards an evidence requirement now: VALID,
on a link not ended, pinned to a CLEAN version (CTL-20).

EvidenceReferenceStatus.description: ERD `evidence_reference.status`. A WITHDRAWN reference satisfies no requirement; it stays as history.

ExternalEntityCreateRequest.description: ADM-013: an external entity, ACTIVE on creation (ADR-013).

ExternalEntityDetail.description: An external entity (ADR-013). Its people may sign in and act only while it is ACTIVE.

ExternalEntityUpdateRequest.description: ADM-013: the entity's editable representation in full; the code is fixed.

FinancialCommitmentCreateRequest.description: A new Approved Budget version of the project: FinancialCommitmentRequest and the project.

FinancialCommitmentDetail.description:
One commitment version. bool FinancialCommitmentDetail.IsCurrent marks the ACTIVE one, the budget of record. A field the caller's audience may
not see (ADR-010) is null here and named in IReadOnlyList<string> FinancialCommitmentDetail.MaskedFields; the API omits it (R-20). Its review history is
`GET /approval-instances?subjectModule=FinancialKpi&subjectType=FinancialCommitment&subjectId={id}`.

FinancialCommitmentPage.description: A project's commitment versions, newest first (R-29).

FinancialCommitmentRequest.description:
An Approved Budget version's figures, as a whole (R-5): the project total in SAR (R-16), when it applies from, and its manual
provenance — a document or system reference and the date the figure is true as of. Who entered it is the caller; the status,
version and revision are the workflow's.

FinancialField.description: ERD `financial_source_mode.field_code`: the financial fields whose source is set per project (ADR-008).

FinancialPortfolioAggregate.description:
Financial totals over a portfolio of projects, in SAR. A project counts only when its figures are measured, visible to the
caller and verified as SAR; otherwise it is listed in IReadOnlyList<AggregateExclusion> FinancialPortfolioAggregate.Exclusions and bool FinancialPortfolioAggregate.IsPartial is true. With no
project counted, every total is null — never 0.

FinancialPositionDetail.description:
A project's CURRENT/LIVE financial position, computed on read and never stored: the ACTIVE Approved Budget, and the figures of
the latest revision submitted for review or published. FinancialStatus FinancialPositionDetail.FinancialStatus is rated under the thresholds in force
now, UNKNOWN when there are none or a figure is missing (Guid? FinancialPositionDetail.ThresholdConfigurationVersionId null). Distinct from
every PublishedFinancialSnapshotDetail (M-12).

FinancialPositionPage.description: A project's live financial position: one item for a project the caller may see, none otherwise (R-29).

FinancialProgressUpdateDetail.description:
One revision of a period's CURRENT/LIVE actuals and forecast. A figure that is not known is null and
ValueStatus FinancialProgressUpdateDetail.ValueStatus says why — never 0 (TASK-052). Masked fields as FinancialCommitmentDetail.

FinancialProgressUpdatePage.description: A project's financial update revisions, newest first (R-29).

FinancialProgressUpdateRequest.description:
A DRAFT update's figures, as a whole (R-5). A figure that is not known is sent as null, with `valueStatus` saying why
(MISSING, STALE, NOT_APPLICABLE) — never as `"0.00"`. A figure is present exactly when MEASURED.

FinancialProgressUpdateStartRequest.description: Opens the financial update of the project's next period. Every figure starts Unknown; nothing else is sent.

FinancialSourceModeCreateRequest.description: Sets a financial field's source mode for the first time (ADR-008).

FinancialSourceModeDetail.description:
The source mode of one financial field of a project. A field never configured is MANUAL, the launch mode, with no
Guid? FinancialSourceModeDetail.Id (ADR-008).

FinancialSourceModePage.description: A project's financial fields and their source modes, in field order (R-29).

FinancialSourceModeRequest.description: A field's source mode, as a whole (R-5).

FinancialSourceType.description: Where a financial figure came from (ADR-008 extension, TASK-108; ERD D-10 `source_type`).

FinancialStatus.description:
ERD `published_financial_snapshot.financial_status`. UNKNOWN is a value of its own: a position without the figures to
rate it is UNKNOWN, never coerced to a colour.

GovernanceProfileEntry.description: The switches of one governance profile (ADR-015). The assignment thresholds are OQ-014's and may be absent.

GovernedLifecycleState.description:
The governed lifecycle of everything authored and published (ERD D-12; Blueprint Section 12, TASK-034).
A PUBLISHED row is immutable; an abandoned draft is RETIRED, never deleted.

GovernedRecord.description: The governed lifecycle columns of a row (ERD D-12): its state, and who authored, validated and published it, and when.

HealthStatus.description:
A health rating. UNKNOWN is a value of its own: a rating whose inputs are missing is UNKNOWN, never coerced to a
colour (ERD `published_progress_snapshot.overall_health`).

KpiAssignmentCreateRequest.description: Assigns a PUBLISHED catalogue KPI to a project: its owner, if any, and a PUBLISHED MEASUREMENT_FREQUENCY item.

KpiAssignmentDetail.description: A KPI assigned to a project, with the definition's unit, so a reader can tell which measurements compare.

KpiAssignmentPage.description: A project's KPI assignments, newest first (R-29).

KpiAssignmentRequest.description: An assignment's owner and frequency, as a whole (R-5). Its project and KPI never change.

KpiAssignmentStatus.description: ERD `kpi_assignment.status`: ACTIVE and SUSPENDED move both ways; RETIRED is final.

KpiDefinitionCreateRequest.description: A new KPI definition, created DRAFT.

KpiDefinitionDetail.description: A stable KPI identity. Its calculation rule and thresholds are versioned KPI_POLICY configuration (OQ-006).

KpiDefinitionUpdateRequest.description: A KPI definition's editable representation in full; the code is fixed.

KpiMeasurementCreateRequest.description: A new measurement of the assignment for a period: KpiMeasurementRequest, the assignment and the period.

KpiMeasurementDetail.description:
A measurement and the target version it is pinned to, as that version stands (it never changes once ACTIVE). A value that is
not known is null and ValueStatus KpiMeasurementDetail.ValueStatus says why; KpiRagStatus KpiMeasurementDetail.RagStatus is then UNKNOWN or NOT_APPLICABLE — never 0,
never GREEN. Masked fields as FinancialCommitmentDetail.

KpiMeasurementPage.description: An assignment's measurements, latest period first (R-29).

KpiMeasurementRequest.description:
A DRAFT measurement's value, as a whole (R-5). A value that is not known is sent as null with `valueStatus` saying why —
never as 0. Its period and its pinned target version never change.

KpiMeasurementStatus.description: ERD `kpi_measurement.status`: DRAFT → SUBMITTED → PUBLISHED. PUBLISHED is final.

KpiPolicyEntry.description: The calculation rule and RAG thresholds of a PUBLISHED KPI definition (OQ-006).

KpiPortfolioAggregate.description:
The latest PUBLISHED measurement of each requested KPI on each requested project. Values are combined only when every KPI
measures in one unit (bool KpiPortfolioAggregate.IsUnitCompatible); otherwise decimal? KpiPortfolioAggregate.MeanValue is null and the aggregate is
partial. RAG ratings are unitless and always counted. A measurement without a value counts in the RAG counts and is listed
in IReadOnlyList<AggregateExclusion> KpiPortfolioAggregate.Exclusions.

KpiRagCounts.description: The count of each RAG rating among the counted measurements.

KpiRagStatus.description:
ERD `kpi_measurement.rag_status`, rated against the pinned target version. UNKNOWN when there is no figure or no
thresholds to rate it by, NOT_APPLICABLE when the KPI does not apply to the period: neither is ever coerced to a colour.

KpiTargetVersionCreateRequest.description: A new target version of the assignment: KpiTargetVersionRequest and the assignment.

KpiTargetVersionDetail.description:
One target version. bool KpiTargetVersionDetail.IsCurrent marks the ACTIVE one, the version a measurement recorded now pins. Its review
history is `GET /approval-instances?subjectModule=FinancialKpi&subjectType=KpiTargetVersion&subjectId={id}`.

KpiTargetVersionPage.description: An assignment's target versions, newest first (R-29).

KpiTargetVersionRequest.description:
A target version's figures, as a whole (R-5): the target in the KPI's unit and the RAG thresholds, both or neither, to four
places (numeric(18,4)).

Language.description: The two platform languages (ADR-012). Persisted as the ISO 639-1 code in a `char(2)` column.

MaskingRule.description: What an audience without clearance sees of a classified field (ADR-010).

MasterDataCatalogueDetail.description: A controlled list of ADM-020–029. The catalogues are the platform's (db/seed); only the name is AHDA's to edit.

MasterDataCatalogueUpdateRequest.description: ADM-020–029: a catalogue's editable representation, its bilingual name.

MasterDataItemCreateRequest.description: ADM-020–029: a new item of a catalogue, created DRAFT.

MasterDataItemDetail.description: A controlled value, with who authored, validated and published it (ERD D-12).

MasterDataItemUpdateRequest.description: ADM-020–029: an item's editable representation in full; the catalogue and code are fixed.

MaterialityBandEntry.description: One of the three change-routing bands of a governance profile (ADR-016).

MfaChallengeCreateRequest.description: Starts the second factor of a sign-in with the MFA token the first factor returned.

MfaSessionCreateRequest.description: Completes a sign-in with the second factor: the MFA token, the challenge and the code the person entered.

MilestoneAchievementCreateRequest.description:
A new revision of a milestone's achievement claim: the shared milestone it claims, and the claim
MilestoneAchievementRequest describes. The same request opens a first claim, a claim after a return, and a
correction of an accepted achievement.

MilestoneAchievementDetail.description:
One revision of a milestone's achievement claim. bool MilestoneAchievementDetail.IsCurrent marks the milestone's ACCEPTED revision, whose
DateOnly? MilestoneAchievementDetail.AcceptedActualAchievementDate is the milestone's Actual Achievement Date (ICD-04). A SUPERSEDED revision keeps
its accepted date and names the revision that superseded it. Its review history is
`GET /approval-instances?subjectModule=Milestone&subjectType=MilestoneAchievement&subjectId={id}`.

MilestoneAchievementRequest.description:
A DRAFT's claim, as a whole (R-5): the date the milestone was achieved on and, optionally, what the claimant says of it. The
status, the accepted date and the review are set by the workflow, never sent; an unknown property is ignored.

MilestoneAchievementStatus.description:
ERD `milestone_achievement.status` (TASK-050). A revision is born DRAFT and SUBMITTED to WF-11; the outcome makes it
ACCEPTED or RETURNED. An ACCEPTED revision becomes SUPERSEDED when a later revision of the same milestone is accepted.
RETURNED and SUPERSEDED are final: a correction is always a new revision, never an edit.

MilestoneEvidenceDetail.description:
A revision's evidence (PTBC-006): the EVIDENCE_POLICY version in force now and the evidence types it makes mandatory for the
milestone's category, the types the revision holds satisfying evidence for (a VALID reference to a CLEAN version on an
active link), and its links. Guid? MilestoneEvidenceDetail.EvidencePolicyVersionId is null while no EVIDENCE_POLICY version is published:
then nothing is mandatory yet, which the UI labels optional pending policy.

MilestoneEvidenceRequest.description: A document to attach as evidence: the document, the version of it to pin, and the EVIDENCE_TYPE item it is evidence of.

MobileVerificationChallenge.description: A code sent to the user's mobile number; string MobileVerificationChallenge.ChallengeId is returned with the code to confirm it.

MobileVerificationResult.description: The number the user confirmed, and when.

NarrativeText.description:
Free text a person typed, tagged with the language it was entered in (ADR-012 extension, TASK-109; ERD D-7).
Maps to a `<field> text` / `<field>_lang char(2)` column pair. Nothing is translated:
the tag records the entry language and is set once, at entry, because it cannot be backfilled later.

NarrativeTextRequest.description: Free text in the language it was entered in (ERD D-7; R-18).

NotificationChannel.description: The three launch channels (ADR-004): FG-04 routes event families to them (TASK-034) and WF-15 delivers on them (TASK-039).

NotificationChannelEntry.description: A channel of an event family; bool NotificationChannelEntry.EnabledByDefault is what a recipient starts with.

NotificationChannelPreference.description: IsConfigurable is false for in-app and for every channel of a mandatory family.

NotificationEventFamilyEntry.description:
One event family across ADR-004's three matrices: Mandatory or User-configurable (bool NotificationEventFamilyEntry.IsMandatory), its
channels (event family → channel) and the roles it reaches (recipient role → event family).

NotificationHistoryItem.description: One delivery to the caller on any channel, with what became of it (SCR-153). The content is in-app's; see NotificationSummary.

NotificationIntentDetail.description: An intent with every delivery it produced. Rendered content is its recipient's to read, so it is not shown here.

NotificationIntentStatus.description: Where a received intent is on its way to its recipients (ERD §6 row 43).

NotificationPreferenceItemRequest.description: One family on one channel, turned on or off.

NotificationPreferenceSet.description: The caller's channels for every family of the routing configuration in force (SCR-154).

NotificationPreferencesUpdateRequest.description: The caller's choices to set; a family and channel not listed keeps its current choice.

NotificationSummary.description: An in-app notification as its recipient sees it (SCR-150–152, MOD-070). string NotificationSummary.Language is `ar` or `en`, the language it was rendered in.

NotificationTemplateCreateRequest.description: A new template version, created DRAFT. The content rules (bilingual, SMS limits) are the module's.

ParticipationMode.description:
Who manages a project's day-to-day record (ADR-013). Shared because a Project carries it and FG-04's
participation rules are keyed on it.

ParticipationRuleEntry.description: Whether a contribution type is enabled for projects in a participation mode (ADR-013).

PermissionProfileDetail.description: ADM-009 Permission Matrix for one profile: every version, newest first, with its grants.

PermissionProfileGrantDetail.description: One cell of the matrix: a catalogue permission at a data scope.

PermissionProfileVersionDetail.description: A profile version and its grants; only a PUBLISHED version may be assigned (ADR-018).

PermissionSummary.description: An entry of the protected permission catalogue. Guid? PermissionSummary.DataClassificationItemId is its clearance (ADR-010).

ProgressOverrideRequest.description: ADR-009: an override of the project roll-up, 0–100 to four places, and the reason for it, which is required.

ProgressSubmissionDetail.description:
One revision of a period's progress, with actual and planned side by side (ADR-009). decimal ProgressSubmissionDetail.ActualPercent is
the reported figure: the override when bool ProgressSubmissionDetail.IsOverridden, else the calculated one, which is always kept.
Guid? ProgressSubmissionDetail.ProjectIntakeId marks the ADR-014 opening position.

ProgressSubmissionPage.description: One page of a project's progress revisions, newest first (R-29).

ProgressSubmissionRequest.description:
What a person writes on a DRAFT, as a whole (R-5): the narrative and the override. There is no actual or planned
percentage: both are derived (ADR-009), and an unknown property is ignored.

ProgressSubmissionStartRequest.description: Starts the progress update of the project's next period. The figures are derived; nothing else is sent.

ProgressSubmissionStatus.description:
The review and publication workflow of one revision of a period's progress (TASK-044). RETURNED and PUBLISHED are
final: a returned revision is followed by revision + 1.

ProjectBaselineDetail.description: A baseline of the project, APPROVED or DECLARED (ADR-014), with its place in the project's baseline history.

ProjectBaselinePage.description: A project's baselines, latest version first (R-29).

ProjectBaselineStatus.description:
ERD `project_baseline.status`. A candidate is DRAFT, SUBMITTED to WF-11, and ends ACTIVE, RETURNED (resubmitted
as the next revision), REJECTED or WITHDRAWN; an ACTIVE baseline becomes SUPERSEDED when another activates.
UNDER_REVIEW is in the ERD's value set but no edge reaches it: WF-11 gives the source no signal between start and
outcome (schedule-baseline.md F-8).

ProjectDetail.description:
A project as SCR-026 shows it. string? ProjectDetail.FormalProjectId is null until AHDA approves the registration.
DateOnly? ProjectDetail.LegacyIntakeDate is set only on a project that entered by the legacy intake path (ADR-014, TASK-104): its
baseline is a Declared Baseline, never an Approved one, so every display can tell the two apart.

ProjectHealthStatusDetail.description: The CURRENT/LIVE Overall Project Health, computed from the derived figures, with when it was computed.

ProjectHealthStatusPage.description: A project's live health: one item once it has been computed, none before (R-29).

ProjectLifecycleState.description:
TASK-041 (Draft → Submitted → Under Review → Returned / Approved-Planned; Planned → Active), TASK-062
(Active ↔ Suspended), TASK-063 (Completed → Closed; Closed is terminal).

ProjectMilestoneCreateRequest.description: A new milestone of the project's schedule: the project, and the inputs ProjectMilestoneRequest describes.

ProjectMilestoneDetail.description:
A milestone as WF-03 holds it (ICD-04): its schedule representation and status, with the ACTIVE baseline's planned date and
the forecast's variance from it in working days, positive = late; both null when the ACTIVE baseline does not include the
milestone, or there is none. Its achievement — evidence and the accepted Actual Achievement Date — is WF-05's:
`GET /milestone-achievements?projectMilestoneId={id}`.

ProjectMilestonePage.description: A project's milestones, earliest forecast first (R-29).

ProjectMilestoneRequest.description:
A milestone's inputs, as a whole (R-5): its title, its MILESTONE_CATEGORY item, its Current Forecast date, the activity it
completes, if any, and its sort order. The status is set by its commands and by WF-05's acceptance, never sent.

ProjectMilestoneStatus.description:
ERD `project_milestone.status`. WF-03 plans and cancels a milestone; ACHIEVED is set by WF-03 when WF-05 accepts an
achievement of it (ICD-04, TASK-050). ACHIEVED and CANCELLED are final.

ProjectRequest.description:
MOD-001 Create Project and the edit of a DRAFT or RETURNED project: the whole registration (R-5). There is no
`formalProjectId`: AHDA issues it on approval (ADR-013).

ProjectScheduleDetail.description: A project's working schedule, with the baseline that is ACTIVE now, if any.

ProjectSchedulePage.description: A project's schedule: one item once initialized (R-29).

ProjectSubmitCommand.description: Submitting names the project's manager (ADR-013): an R04 holder over the project, internal or of its delivering entity.

ProjectSummary.description: A row of SCR-025 Project Register.

ProjectTaskCreateRequest.description: A new task of the project, or a subtask of `parentTaskId`, with the inputs ProjectTaskRequest describes.

ProjectTaskRequest.description:
A task's plan and assignment, as a whole (R-5): the schedule activity it executes against, its title and description, its
owner and priority, and its planned dates. The planned duration is derived from the dates, never sent; status, actual dates
and percentages change only through the commands. An unknown property is ignored.

ProjectTaskStatus.description: ERD `project_task.status` (TASK-048). CANCELLED is final; COMPLETED is left only by a reopen.

PublishedFinancialSnapshotDetail.description: The PUBLISHED/OFFICIAL financial position of a period, as stored at publication and never since changed.

PublishedFinancialSnapshotPage.description: A project's published financial snapshots, latest first (R-29).

PublishedProgressSnapshotDetail.description: A PUBLISHED/OFFICIAL period record, as it was published; nothing changes it afterwards.

PublishedProgressSnapshotPage.description: One page of a project's published snapshots, latest first (R-29).

ReportFieldEntry.description: A field the SCR-138 controlled explorer may expose (ADR-019); masking applies at execution (ADR-010).

ReportingCyclePage.description: One page of a project's reporting periods, earliest first (R-29).

ReportingCycleStatus.description: A reporting period is OPEN until its progress is published, then CLOSED for good (TASK-044).

ResolvedConfiguration.description:
The content of the version that resolution chose, with the id a record pins (ERD D-13). Each `Require…`
returns the entry or throws ConfigurationMissingException: there is no default to fall back on.

RiskAcceptanceStatus.description: ERD `risk_acceptance.status`: ACTIVE until it EXPIRES on its date or is REVOKED; both are final.

RiskAcceptCommand.description: An acceptance until `expiresOn`, the first day it no longer holds, with why the risk is tolerated meanwhile.

RiskAssessCommand.description:
An assessment: a probability level and one impact level for each dimension of the matrix in force, 1–5 (ADR-011). The overall
impact and the rating are the server's; a client never sends them.

RiskAssessmentDetail.description:
One assessment version, whole: its probability, its impact per dimension, the overall impact (the highest of them) and the
rating, all as recorded against Guid RiskAssessmentDetail.MatrixConfigurationVersionId. Nothing in it changes when the matrix is
published again.

RiskAssessmentPage.description: A risk's assessment versions, newest first.

RiskAssessmentSummary.description: The figures of an assessment that decide its rating.

RiskCloseCommand.description: Why the risk is closed; required, never empty (TASK-056's closure rationale, enforced here too).

RiskCreateRequest.description: A new risk of the project, IDENTIFIED, with the fields RiskRequest describes. A rating is never sent: it comes from an assessment.

RiskDetail.description:
A risk register entry. RiskAssessmentSummary? RiskDetail.CurrentAssessment is its latest assessment, whose rating was fixed by the matrix version
that assessment pinned; null while the risk was never assessed. DateOnly? RiskDetail.AcceptedUntil is the expiry of its ACTIVE
acceptance, if it has one. IReadOnlyList<Guid> RiskDetail.MaterialisedIssueIds are the issues WF-07 raised from it (edge 15), each holding the
risk as its `originating_risk_id`: the risk side of the linkage.

RiskMaterialiseCommand.description: The issue to raise from the risk: WF-07's category and priority, and its title and description, the risk's by default.

RiskMatrixCellEntry.description: A matrix cell, naming its rating by code within the same version.

RiskPage.description: A project's risks, most recently changed first (R-29; indexing-strategy P-2).

RiskRatingDetail.description: A rating as the pinned RISK_MATRIX version defines it (ADR-011; labels outstanding, OQ-006).

RiskRatingEntry.description: A rating the matrix yields, e.g. HIGH. The code is unique within the version.

RiskRequest.description:
A risk's register fields, as a whole (R-5): title, description, category, owner, the day it was identified and its next review.
Status, rating and closure change only through the commands. An unknown property is ignored.

RiskStatus.description: ERD `risk.status` (TASK-055): Identified → Assessed → Treatment/Monitoring → Closed. CLOSED is left only by a reopen.

RiskTreatmentActionCreateRequest.description: A new action of the risk, PLANNED, with the plan RiskTreatmentActionRequest describes.

RiskTreatmentActionPage.description: A risk's treatment actions, oldest first.

RiskTreatmentActionRequest.description: An action's plan, as a whole (R-5): title, description, type (MITIGATE, AVOID, TRANSFER, CONTINGENCY), owner and due date.

RiskTreatmentActionStatus.description: ERD `risk_treatment_action.status`: PLANNED → IN_PROGRESS → COMPLETED, and CANCELLED from either open state. COMPLETED and CANCELLED are final.

RiskTreatmentActionType.description: ERD `risk_treatment_action.action_type`. Accepting a risk is not an action: it is a RiskAcceptance.

RoleDetail.description: ADM-007 Role Detail, with the permission profiles rooted at the role (ADR-018).

RoleSummary.description: A row of ADM-006 Roles: one of the canonical R01–R08.

RoleUpdateRequest.description: ADM-008: a canonical role's editable representation, its bilingual name.

ScheduleActivityCreateRequest.description: A new activity of the project's schedule: the project, and the inputs ScheduleActivityRequest describes.

ScheduleActivityDetail.description:
An activity with its three sets of dates side by side (BR-SCH-002): the working plan, the Current Forecast, and the
ACTIVE baseline's copy, with the forecast's variance from the baseline in working days, positive = late. The baseline
dates and the variance are null when the ACTIVE baseline does not include the activity, or there is none.

ScheduleActivityPage.description: A project's activities in work-breakdown order (R-29).

ScheduleActivityStatus.description:
ERD `schedule_activity.status`. WF-03 writes PLANNED and CANCELLED; IN_PROGRESS and COMPLETED are execution
states WF-04 reports (the spec's DCL-SCH-18). CANCELLED is final.

ScheduleDependencyRequest.description:
A dependency between two leaf activities: FS, SS or FF (BR-SCH-024; SF is deferred) with a non-negative lag in working
days, 0 when absent (BR-SCH-025).

ScheduleDependencyType.description:
The dependency types of the WF-03 MVP (the spec's BR-SCH-024, DCL-SCH-07): finish-to-start, start-to-start and
finish-to-finish. Start-to-finish is deferred, although the ERD lists it (schedule-baseline.md F-11).

ScheduleForecastRequest.description: A leaf's Current Forecast: when it is now expected to start and finish.

ScheduleHealth.description:
Schedule Health (ERD `schedule_health_status.schedule_health`): the spec's On Track, At Risk and Delayed are
GREEN, AMBER and RED. UNKNOWN is a value of its own, never coerced to a colour.

ScheduleHealthStatusDetail.description: The CURRENT/LIVE Schedule Health, as WF-03 last computed it.

ScheduleHealthStatusPage.description: A project's live Schedule Health: one item once computed (R-29).

ScheduleProjectRequest.description: A command on a project's schedule that names only the project: initializing it, opening a baseline candidate.

SemanticState.description:
Which of the two views a financial representation is (api-conventions R-20(c), M-12): the CURRENT/LIVE position, computed on
read from the figures as they stand, or the PUBLISHED/OFFICIAL snapshot, fixed at publication. They are never merged.

SingleSignOnIntegrationStatus.description: The OIDC client settings. Authority, client id and callback URL are Public in the Environment and Secrets sheet; the client secret is reduced to whether it is set.

SourceMode.description:
ERD `financial_source_mode.source_mode` (ADR-008 gate): MANUAL at launch; INTEGRATED and HYBRID are built and left
unconnected. A field that is INTEGRATED takes no manual figure, and never goes back to MANUAL: manual substitution during
a source outage is not permitted.

SsoSessionCreateRequest.description:
Completes an SSO sign-in: the `code` and `state` the identity provider redirected to
`SSO_OIDC_CALLBACK_URL` with, and the `transaction` from SsoAuthorizationDetail.

StepUpChallengeCommand.description: Starts a step-up of the session the refresh token continues (ADR-010).

StepUpCommand.description:
Completes a step-up: the session's refresh token, the challenge and the code. The answer is the session's next token
pair, whose authentication time is now.

TaskBlockCommand.description: Why the task is blocked, in the language it was entered in.

TaskDependencyPage.description: A project's task dependencies, oldest first (R-29).

TaskDependencyRequest.description:
A blocking dependency between two leaf tasks: FS or SS holds back the successor's start until the predecessor is completed
or has started, FF or SF its completion.

TaskDependencyType.description:
ERD `task_dependency.dependency_type`: which point of the predecessor gates which step of the successor. The first letter
is the predecessor's point (Start = started, Finish = completed), the second the successor's step it gates.

TaskProgressCommand.description: A leaf's actual percentage, 0–100 to four places (ADR-009).

UserCreateRequest.description:
ADM-004 Create User. An internal user is linked to the directory by string? UserCreateRequest.DirectorySubjectId, which sign-in
matches (ADR-007); an external user belongs to Guid? UserCreateRequest.ExternalEntityId (ADR-013). string? UserCreateRequest.PreferredLanguage
defaults to `ar`.

UserMobileVerificationCommand.description: The code the user received on their mobile number, for the challenge it was sent under (ADR-004).

UserStatus.description: TASK-031: activate and disable; disabling never rewrites historical attribution.

UserSummary.description: A row of ADM-002 User List.

UserType.description:
EXTERNAL covers contributors and entity Project Managers alike: what makes an entity Project Manager is the
grant, not the person (ADR-013). SERVICE is the non-human principal that lets `created_by` be not null.

UserUpdateRequest.description: ADM-005 Edit User: the editable representation in full (R-5); user type and entity are fixed at creation.

ValueStatus.description:
ERD `value_status` on financial updates and KPI measurements: whether there is a figure, and if not, why. A figure is
present exactly when MEASURED; MISSING, STALE and NOT_APPLICABLE carry none and are never read as zero (TASK-052).
